youtube.description:
Claude API Python quickstart: create a key, install the SDK, send a message, print the reply. 4 steps.

Claude API Python quickstart: your first call in 4 steps. You need a Console account.

1. Key - Create an API key in the Claude Console.
2. Install - Run pip install anthropic, in a virtual environment.
3. Send - Call client.messages.create with a model and a prompt.
4. Print - Loop over message.content and print the text.

Needs: API, not chat plans

Official docs: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/get-started
